spanish: Y lo degollará sobre muslo del altar, Tsafónah, delante de Jehová, y echarán hijos de Aarón, los sacerdotes, su sangre sobre el altar alrededor.

findings.issue: Common noun (H6828, feminine singular absolute) plus directional suffix left untranslated as the name-like form Tsafónah; the token licenses north plus direction, not a proper name.

notes: Aarón and Jehová match locked forms; the other tokens are reflected in the Spanish.
